PROGRAMME BOARD MEETING MINUTES
The programme board met on 17 August to confirm the autumn workshop schedule and assign publication checks.
OPENING ITEMS
The chair confirmed that venue access and captioning support must be checked before invitations are issued.
DECISIONS RECORDED
Members agreed to publish the draft schedule only after each session owner verifies its learning outcomes and contact details.
FOLLOW-UP ACTIONS
The secretariat will circulate the revised agenda on Friday and collect outstanding accessibility notes by the following Tuesday.
